title: API config + runtime arch scratchpad (Alex Kim)
content:
Purpose:
- Quick personal scratchpad for API config shape + runtime routing decisions. Not a final PRD - just collecting options and tradeoffs before a proper spec.

Assumptions / goals:
- Single config that can be used across Hosted / Dedicated / Private with minimal overrides.
- Route-level policies: model, batching, cache, fallback.
- Runtime needs to make fast routing decisions (<= 2-3ms) and select kernel profile based on seq_len distribution.

High-level fields to capture (brain dump):
- routes: list of route defs (name, path_prefix, model, models_priority)
- batch_policy: {max_batch_size, max_latency_ms, adaptive: bool}
- cache: {enabled, scope: global|route|user, prefix_ttl_sec, kv_namespace}
- fallback: {on_oom: model_variant, on_timeout: model_variant, region_fallbacks}
- telemetry: {log_level, sample_rate, metrics_tags}

Rough schema sketch (example snippet):
{
  "routes": [
    {
      "name": "chat-default",
      "path_prefix": "/v1/chat",
      "model": "redwood-chat-1",
      "models_priority": ["redwood-chat-1", "redwood-chat-1-quant"],
      "batch_policy": {"max_batch_size": 32, "max_latency_ms": 50, "adaptive": true},
      "cache": {"enabled": true, "scope": "route", "prefix_ttl_sec": 3600, "kv_namespace": "chat-pref"},
      "fallback": {"on_oom": "redwood-chat-1-quant", "on_timeout": "redwood-chat-1-fallback"}
    }
  ]
}

Routing policy notes:
- Evaluate request metadata first (customer tier, region, model pin) -> quick decision tree.
- If capacity constrained, consult models_priority and choose cheapest compatible variant.
- Keep a small in-memory table for route->kernel profile mapping (seq_len histogram derived from sampling).

KV cache behaviour (brainstorm):
- Prefix cache for deterministic prefixes (e.g., system prompts, personas).
- Use per-route or per-tenant namespace to avoid leakage in multi-tenant hosted mode.
- TTL strategy: short TTL for ephemeral chat, longer for embeddings rerank cache.

ASCII runtime diagram (very rough):
Client --> API Gateway --> Auth & Quota --> Router --> Route Engine --> [Batcher | Cache Layer | Model Pool] --> Kernel Selector --> GPU Worker
                              |
                              +--> Telemetry collector (async)

Open questions / TODOs:
- How do we express model compatibility constraints (quantization, max_seq_len) in schema? add fields: compatible_kernels, max_seq_len.
- Should cache by request-hash include non-deterministic flags (temperature, top_p)? probably include only deterministic inputs + normalized params.
- Backwards compatibility: simple config keys + allow freeform "raw_runtime" block for experiments.

Next steps:
- Turn this into a minimal config prototype (yaml) and a small router simulation to validate decision latency.
- Sync w/ SRE + privacy (Priya) on KV namespace isolation for hosted tenants.
- Draft a PRD once simulation shows <3ms routing overhead.

Notes to self:
- Ping Samir about telemetry schema (we need token-level cost breakdown fields).
- Add a sample for embedding route (batch size 4096-ish, caching disabled).

Fragments / quick reminders:
- embedding route: batch_policy.max_batch_size=4096, max_latency_ms=300, cache.enabled=false
- rerank route: cache.prefix_ttl_sec=86400 (cache candidate embeddings)

End of scratchpad.
